_comment: Three Facebook ad landing pages, one per set of pieces. Tick a product's FB Ad 1/2/3 box in the admin tool's Manage Products tab to put it in a set; a piece can be in more than one. 'youtubeId' is the video that set's page plays - leave it empty to fall back to the Why Titanium making-of clip. 'heading' is what customers see above the other sets' rows. A set with nothing ticked simply doesn't appear.
